title: Concept: Cluster internal DNS name in a response
description: A Kubernetes service DNS name with its namespace in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The name gives the service, the namespace and the cluster suffix, which is a complete addressing hint for anything that can reach the cluster network.
applicability: Deployments that render a Kubernetes service DNS name with its namespace into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The name gives the service, the namespace and the cluster suffix, which is a complete addressing hint for anything that can reach the cluster network.
